name: chaos_abdomen
title: CHAOS: abdominal CT and MR (T1 in/out-phase, T2 SPIR) as DICOM series, 40 patients
description: The Combined Healthy Abdominal Organ Segmentation challenge training set: 20 CT and 20 MR patients as anonymised DICOM series, read series by series out of the 890 MB zip on Zenodo (HTTP Range; a series is fetched as a folder of .dcm files). Ground-truth masks are PNG slice stacks in the same archive (folders Ground/) and are not mapped here. Sample ids are set/case (CT/1, MR/1 are different patients).

license.note: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 on the Zenodo record (checked 2026-10-14): non-commercial, share-alike.

citation: Kavur A.E., Gezer N.S., Baris M., et al. CHAOS Challenge - combined (CT-MR) healthy abdominal organ segmentation. Med Image Anal 69:101950, 2021.
